faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before deploying EventGo Proof for your field teams.
faq.q1: Do I need to install software from the App Store or Google Play?
faq.a1: No. EventGo Proof operates as a PWA (Progressive Web App). Simply visit the web address on your mobile browser and tap 'Add to Home Screen' to use it like a native app.
faq.q2: Does the app work in venues with weak mobile signal?
faq.a2: EventGo Proof automatically compresses images on-device before uploading, ensuring reliable uploads even under weak 4G or event venue signals.
faq.q3: Can I export inspection reports for brand clients?
faq.a3: Yes. The platform exports full Excel spreadsheets containing progress metrics, assigned personnel, and verified evidence photo links.
